description: This file is a PHP source file implementing a role hierarchy popup in the vtiger CRM system. It retrieves role hierarchy data from the database, constructs a nested HTML tree using recursive functions, and prepares data for rendering with Smarty templates.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Custom Smarty class for vtiger CRM's templating system.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Recursively constructs HTML for the role hierarchy tree, including expandable/collapsible icons and links for role selection or editing.
